title: Features list the Plans touching them

steps.action: Open a feature whose story a Task names, with an unrelated Plan present.
Add only Tasks naming a story, then open the pages.
steps.expected_result: The lists follow with nothing else authored.

steps.action: Deliver the Roadmap feature holding the story, then list Plans of the receiving feature.
steps.expected_result: The Task keeps its story, and the receiving feature lists the Plan.

expected_result: Each step behaves as its acceptance criterion says.
